name: Chat with Manuals
intro: This is Legion's Chat with Manuals feature, where a technician can ask questions about equipment manuals and get answers with citations.
outro: That is the whole flow: sign in, add a manual, ask a question, and get a cited answer, all running on a local build.

steps.title: Open Chat with Manuals
steps.narration: I start on the Legion home screen and open Chat with Manuals from the main navigation.

steps.title: Upload a manual
steps.narration: Next I upload the OSHA ladder safety manual as a PDF, and it appears as a document chip once it has been indexed.

steps.title: Ask a question
steps.narration: Now I ask how often ladders need to be inspected, and send the question to the assistant.

type.text: What is the ladder inspection interval?

steps.title: Open the citation
steps.narration: Finally I click the citation marker, and the source page from the manual opens beside the answer so I can verify it.
